title: How Overnight Shipping Works
summary: Wendover Productions explains how overnight shipping works, covering the hub-and-spoke logistics of companies like FedEx and UPS and the use of cargo aircraft. It touches on the economics that make next-day delivery possible.
why: Recommended as a clear, accessible explainer on logistics, overnight shipping and why old planes get used for cargo.

quote.text: is a good Youtube video that discusses how overnight shipping systems like Fedex etc. have works.
